source: https://prancingponypub.ru/mesbg2024/forces_of_good/arnor_and_angmar/ (shared profile page for Angmar/Carn Dum units)
additionalRules: An Army of Carn Dum must always contain Aldrac, who is always the Army's General.

Hero warband/follower system (current 'Armies of The Lord of the Rings' edition): each Hero anchors a warband of Independent (non-Hero) followers up to a cap set by their tier for this army list — Hero of Legend: up to 18 followers; Hero of Valour: up to 15; Hero of Fortitude: up to 12; Minor Hero: up to 6; Independent Hero: 0 (occupies a slot in another Hero's warband instead). The army's General is typically a Hero of Valour or Hero of Legend — check this army list's own requirements. Heroic tier is assigned per army list, not an inherent property of the hero.

specialRules.name: Show of Strength
specialRules.text: If a Carn Dum Hero slays one or more enemy models in Combat, then for the duration of the following turn they gain a bonus of +1 to their Fight Value.

specialRules.name: Banners of Carn Dum
specialRules.text: Friendly banners have a range of 6" rather than 3".

specialRules.name: Fierce Charge
specialRules.text: Friendly Warrior models gain a bonus of +1 to their Fight Value in a turn in which they Charge.

specialRules.name: Brutish Cunning
specialRules.text: This model may re-roll a single D6 in a Duel Roll when fighting solely against Infantry models (but not Monster models).

specialRules.text: If this model is Engaged in Combat with an enemy Hero, then this model gains a bonus of +1 To Wound that Hero when making Strikes.

units.name: Fraecht, Vassal of the Witch-king
units.keywords: MAN, ANGMAR, CARN DUM, INFANTRY, HERO, UNIQUE

specialRules.name: Incantations of Power
specialRules.text: During each Priority Phase, after Priority is determined, Fraecht may spend a Will Point to invoke one incantation (effects last until the End Phase): Incantation of Strength — friendly Carn Dum models within 6" re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1. Incantation of Endurance — friendly Carn Dum models within 6" that suffer a Wound ignore it on a D6 roll of 5+. Incantation of Swiftness — friendly Carn Dum models starting their Move within 6" are not slowed by Difficult Terrain (except water).

units.name: Aldrac, Warlord of Carn Dum
units.keywords: MAN, ANGMAR, CARN DUM, INFANTRY, HERO, UNIQUE

specialRules.name: Warlord of Carn Dum
specialRules.text: Friendly Carn Dum models within 6" of Aldrac must re-roll failed Courage Tests.

specialRules.name: Battle Frenzy
specialRules.text: If Aldrac slays an enemy model he was Engaged in Combat with, then in the following turn he may declare a Heroic Combat for free.
